methods.name: Stage-Progression
methods.rationale: Applies typical Seed → next-stage step-up multiplier (2.5x) to $7M total raised proxy.

methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.skip_reason: insufficient narrow peer set in Transportation (found 0 same-stage, 0 adjacent-stage, 0 similar-tier; need ≥3)
methods.rationale: 3 same-sector peers exist in Transportation, but none of the narrow filters (same-stage / adjacent-stage / similar-valuation-tier) yielded ≥3 datapoints. Falling back to all-sector median would be misleading.

data.narrative:
Navier, a seed-stage transportation company that has raised $7.2M to date, operates within a sector populated by six private peers including Rivian, The Boring Company, and Einride. No public transportation comparables exist at an equivalent valuation tier, limiting traditional public market triangulation.

Stage-progression methodology applies here, using the $7M raised as a baseline proxy and applying a 2.5x multiplier typical of seed-to-next-stage advancement in venture capital. This yields an implied valuation of $18M. Peer-median analysis was not applicable; while three same-sector peers exist, none satisfied the filter criteria of same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar valuation tier needed to establish a credible narrow peer set. Relying on all-sector medians would introduce unacceptable noise given the heterogeneity of transportation venture outcomes.

The triangulation analysis supports a valuation range of $15M to $21M, centered at $18M. This range reflects a 15% downside and upside band around the stage-progression result, accounting for execution risk inherent at the seed stage. Key uncertainties include the absence of matured seed-stage transportation comparables and the sensitivity of the range to capital efficiency—whether Navier deploys the $7.2M at pace and achieves prototype or revenue milestones will materially influence next-round pricing. Further valuation precision requires either expanded peer data at equivalent stage/sector position or clarity on near-term operational inflection points.
